purpose: Bind parts/spares selection and procurement handoff to exact asset compatibility and provenance.
allowed_actions: Flag obsolete/unavailable parts and request engineering/OEM/procurement review.
forbidden_actions: Substitute a part from name/appearance/text similarity alone.
Treat supplier listing as engineering compatibility approval.
failure_boundary: If exact compatibility or substitution authority is missing, HOLD the part decision and hand off to OEM/engineering/procurement as appropriate.
